archetypes.name: race-guard
archetypes.rationale: Step 6 now blocks on marker/status ordering and should preserve existing non-race branches.
archetypes.prompt_body: Review the Step 6 prelude and cleanup guards for ordering and edge-case correctness. Confirm missing sidecar without a marker still follows the legacy skip/preserve paths. Confirm a status sidecar wins over a stale marker. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
